notes: All source_field values are Terraform attribute keys (attr map keys passed to AdditionalConnectionDetailsFn).
aws_sdk_field gives the equivalent AWS SDK v2 Go struct field path for native controller implementors.
creation_only=true means the value is returned by AWS only at creation time and cannot be retrieved from describe/get APIs.
Indexed keys (e.g. instance_0_console_url) use runtime indices; actual key names at runtime include the numeric index.

connection_detail_keys.description: The IAM access key ID, used as the username for programmatic access.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Available as the external-name / resource ID. Can be retrieved via ListAccessKeys.

connection_detail_keys.description: The IAM secret access key. Used as password for programmatic access.
connection_detail_keys.notes: AWS only returns the secret access key once at creation. Cannot be retrieved afterwards. Native controller must store it from the Create response.

connection_detail_keys.description: The DNS address of the RDS cluster writer endpoint.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Available via DescribeDBClusters. Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.description: The DNS address of the RDS cluster reader endpoint (load-balanced across replicas).
connection_detail_keys.notes: Available via DescribeDBClusters. Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.description: The master username for the RDS cluster.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Available via DescribeDBClusters. Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.description: The port on which the RDS cluster accepts connections.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Available via DescribeDBClusters. Type: *int32. Formatted as string with fmt.Sprintf("%v", port).

connection_detail_keys.description: The connection endpoint in address:port format.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Terraform composes this as address:port. AWS SDK has Endpoint.Address and Endpoint.Port separately.

connection_detail_keys.description: The hostname of the RDS instance.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.description: Alias for address — the hostname of the RDS instance. Same value as 'address'.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Both 'address' and 'host' keys are set from the same source field.

connection_detail_keys.description: The master username for the RDS instance.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.description: The port on which the RDS instance accepts connections.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: *int32. Formatted as string with fmt.Sprintf("%v", port).

connection_detail_keys.aws_sdk_field: N/A — not available via AWS describe APIs
connection_detail_keys.description: The master password. Only available in TF state immediately after creation/update.
connection_detail_keys.notes: AWS does not return the password in DescribeDBInstances. Native controller must persist it from CreateDBInstance input or a password secret. If auto-generated via PasswordGenerator, read from the referenced secret.

connection_detail_keys.aws_sdk_field: DescribeGlobalClustersOutput.GlobalClusters[0] (no direct Endpoint field in AWS API — may not be populated)
connection_detail_keys.description: The endpoint for the global cluster, if available.
connection_detail_keys.notes: The aws_rds_global_cluster TF resource exposes an 'endpoint' attribute but it may be empty/null in practice. Check if the AWS SDK GlobalCluster struct has an Endpoint field; if not, this key will never be populated.

connection_detail_keys.description: The DNS name of the Memcached cluster configuration endpoint. Only populated for Memcached engine clusters.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Only applicable to Memcached clusters (not Redis). Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.description: The port number on which the cache cluster accepts connections.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Formatted as string with fmt.Sprintf("%v", port). For Redis, use CacheNodes[0].Endpoint.Port.

connection_detail_keys.description: The address of the replication group configuration endpoint. Only set for cluster-mode enabled groups.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Populated only when cluster mode is enabled. Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.description: The address of the primary node endpoint for the replication group.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: *string. Populated when cluster mode is disabled.

connection_detail_keys.description: The address of the reader endpoint for the replication group (load-balanced across replicas).
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.description: The port number on which the replication group accepts connections.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Formatted as string with fmt.Sprintf("%v", port). Type: *int32.

connection_detail_keys.description: Address of the Nth endpoint (indexed). Key format: endpoint_0_address, endpoint_1_address, etc.
connection_detail_keys.notes: The TF attr 'endpoint' is a list; each entry has 'address' and 'port' sub-fields. In practice, there is typically only one endpoint (i=0). AWS SDK ServerlessCache has a single Endpoint field.

connection_detail_keys.description: Port of the Nth endpoint (indexed). Key format: endpoint_0_port, endpoint_1_port, etc.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Formatted with fmt.Sprintf("%v", port).

connection_detail_keys.description: Address of the Nth reader endpoint (indexed). Key format: reader_endpoint_0_address, etc.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.description: Port of the Nth reader endpoint (indexed). Key format: reader_endpoint_0_port, etc.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Formatted with fmt.Sprintf("%v", port).

connection_detail_keys.description: The domain-specific endpoint used to submit index, search, and data upload requests to the OpenSearch domain.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: *string. Note: newer OpenSearch SDK versions may use Endpoints map instead of Endpoint string for VPC domains.

connection_detail_keys.description: The PEM-encoded certificate for the private CA.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Retrieved via GetCertificateAuthorityCertificate API call. Available only after the CA has been activated.

connection_detail_keys.description: The PEM-encoded certificate chain for the private CA.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Retrieved via GetCertificateAuthorityCertificate API call. May be empty for root CAs.

connection_detail_keys.description: The PEM-encoded certificate signing request (CSR) for the private CA.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Retrieved via GetCertificateAuthorityCsr API call. Used to issue the CA certificate from a parent CA.

connection_detail_keys.description: The PEM-encoded certificate issued by the private CA.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Retrieved via GetCertificate API call using certificate ARN and CA ARN.

connection_detail_keys.description: The PEM-encoded certificate chain for the issued certificate.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Retrieved via GetCertificate API call.

connection_detail_keys.aws_sdk_field: bucket name (external-name; used in all S3 API calls as Bucket parameter)
connection_detail_keys.description: The S3 bucket name (same as the resource external name / Terraform ID).
connection_detail_keys.notes: This is the bucket name, not a generated ID. Available as the external name.

connection_detail_keys.aws_sdk_field: constructed as arn:aws:s3:::{bucket_name} — not returned directly by S3 APIs
connection_detail_keys.description: The ARN of the S3 bucket.
connection_detail_keys.notes: The S3 GetBucketLocation and related APIs do not return the ARN. Native controllers should construct it: arn:aws:s3:::{bucket_name}.

connection_detail_keys.description: The AWS region where the S3 bucket resides.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: types.BucketLocationConstraint (string). Note: us-east-1 returns empty string from GetBucketLocation.

connection_detail_keys.description: The EFS file system ID (e.g. fs-12345678).
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: *string. This is the external name / Terraform resource ID.

connection_detail_keys.description: The URL of the ActiveMQ Web Console for broker instance i. Key format: instance_0_console_url, instance_1_console_url, etc.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: *string. Only available for ActiveMQ brokers.

connection_detail_keys.description: The IP address of broker instance i. Key format: instance_0_ip_address, instance_1_ip_address, etc.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.description: The Jth endpoint URL of broker instance i. Key format: instance_0_endpoint_0, instance_0_endpoint_1, etc.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: []string. Endpoints include AMQP, STOMP, MQTT, OpenWire protocol URLs depending on broker type.

connection_detail_keys.description: The ARN of the SNS topic.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Available from CreateTopic response and also from GetTopicAttributes (Attributes[TopicArn]). Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.description: The DNS address of the DocumentDB cluster.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: *string. Primary writer endpoint.

connection_detail_keys.description: The ARN of the DocumentDB cluster.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.aws_sdk_field: N/A — not available via AWS describe APIs
connection_detail_keys.description: The master password for the DocumentDB cluster.
connection_detail_keys.notes: AWS does not return the master_password in DescribeDBClusters. Native controller must persist it from CreateDBCluster input or from the referenced password secret (if using PasswordGenerator / auto_generate_password).

connection_detail_keys.description: The URL of the SQS queue.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Type: *string. Also returned in CreateQueueOutput.QueueUrl. This is the primary identifier for sending/receiving messages.

connection_detail_keys.description: Address of the cluster configuration endpoint. Key format: cluster_endpoint_0_address. In practice i=0 always.
connection_detail_keys.notes: The TF attr 'cluster_endpoint' is a list but AWS SDK exposes a single ClusterEndpoint. Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.description: Port of the cluster configuration endpoint. Key format: cluster_endpoint_0_port.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Formatted with fmt.Sprintf("%g", port). Type: *int32 in AWS SDK (float64 in TF).

connection_detail_keys.description: Per-node endpoint address. Key format: shard_node_1_1_endpoint_address (1-indexed). Iterate over all shards and nodes.
connection_detail_keys.notes: Requires DescribeClusters with ShowShardDetails=true to populate Shard.Nodes. Type: *string.

connection_detail_keys.description: Per-node endpoint port. Key format: shard_node_1_1_endpoint_port (1-indexed).
connection_detail_keys.notes: Formatted with fmt.Sprintf("%g", port). Type: *int32 in AWS SDK (float64 in TF).
